name: whale-durable-tool-invocation-replay
instr:
The agent runtime cannot safely retry tool invocations across concurrent turns, cancellation, or process reconstruction without duplicate effects or leaked results. Implement durable replay without changing ordinary dispatch.

Each Tool must classify calls as ReplayReusable, ReplayRecoverable, or ReplayInvocationLocal before durable ownership. Malformed input returns a deterministic ReplayPlan without effects. Build replay keys from canonical JSON, tool name, and call identity. Reject incompatible reuse with ErrReplayConflict, exactly "tool replay identity conflict", before execution.

Grant ReplayExecute to one owner only. Duplicates receive ReplayPending or ReplayReturn with the same normalized ToolResult. Atomically record invocation identity, reservations, and completions so reconstructed ledgers preserve caller-visible successes and failures, tolerate torn trailing records, and never finish incomplete completions. Dispatch execution only after ownership.

Classify locally knowable calls without underlying effects. Guarded rejections are replayable without touching wrapped tools. MCP annotations and outcomes govern reuse: annotated read-only calls classify without contacting their manager, while unsafe external calls execute once per distinct identity. Cancellation keeps recoverable reservations only; other retries get a fresh opportunity, with normalization unchanged.

Memory remember and forget replay original outcomes without repeating filesystem mutations or changing
